The '''Corsin Retreat''' was where [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] gathered in [[738 BBY]] to discuss the possibility of restructuring the [[Planetary Security Forces]]. The meeting led to the reestablishment of the [[Republic Navy War College/Legends|Republic Naval College]] as the College of Planetary Security Forces.
